purpose: Unique TIF submission generation, validation, and executive summary for the GEMS DOE competition (DrivenData #306)
hypothesis: Geothermal hot springs (>40 C) mark fluid upflow along concealed faults omitted from the USGS/INGENIOUS surface catalogue. Adding GDR hot-spring dots as independent emission pixels, buffered >=3 px from catalogue faults and the H36-1 base, thinned at min_dist=3.0 px (a rung unused by any in-repo submission), targets genuinely missing structure.
mechanism: Start from validated H36-1 base (rung-3.0 re-pack + blind 1-px catalogue-flank prune, 37,660 px). Add dots at GDR hot-spring (>40 C) pixel locations eligible by distance filter (>=3 px from catalogue, >=3 px from base dots). Poisson-disk thin at min_dist=3.0 px. Combine by union. Output single-band float32 GeoTIFF, values exactly {0,1} inside footprint, NaN outside (sample-conformant), CRS EPSG:32611, 3730x3292, 100 m grid.
named_nonfault_mimic: Paleoshoreline, alluvial-fan boundary, lithologic contact, road/earthwork, or fossil hydrothermal spring not associated with a Quaternary fault can create a thermal anomaly without a concealed fault.
layers_involved: data/h36-1 base (rung-3.0 re-packed H19-5 surface + blind flank prune)
physical_signature: Geothermal fluid upflow at spring locations; spatially localized thermal anomaly not explained by catalogue surface traces.
why_catch_missing_faults: Hot springs are independent observations of subsurface fluid pathways. A concealed fault may have no young surface scarp (hence absent from USGS/INGENIOUS) but still channel geothermal fluids to the surface at a spring. This differs from scarp-ridge, topology-link, heat-flow-residual, and Euler-cluster approaches already in the repo.
how_differs_from_repo: No existing in-repo submission uses GDR well/spring observations as dot sources. H36-1 uses packing re-layout + flank prune. H38-1 uses heat-flow residuals + Euler clusters. H41-1 uses thermal-spring pixel locations as an independent physical signal.

holdout_dti.evaluator: 4-quadrant component-hiding holdout (src/gems27/holdout.py), dti_binary (alpha=0.2, beta=0.8, 300 m triangular kernel), paired vs H36-1 base on same folds

leakage_canary.note: Single-feature AUC not computed for this build; thermal-spring locations are derived from independent GDR observations, not from catalogue truth, so leakage via catalogue-derived features is not expected.

correlation_overlap_vs_registry.note: New spring dots are explicitly excluded from within 3 px of H36-1 dots and catalogue faults by construction.
